title: Future work on the record's tools
situation: The operator: retire the ledger. Restated whole from the decision it supersedes, without the ledger's items.
decision: Remaining, each a task when taken up: (1) one decision may supersede several by name; (2) the lead's handover is named for what it holds, a story or a task, never one word for both; (3) an incomplete handover is matched to the form whose own parts are most present.
